action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    
    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
        (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
        (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, future_horizon = shape
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_weights = np.sum(raw_weights)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights
    
    # Compute losses
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margin
